{{RV|type=function

|eff= global

|descr= Set a task description. {{Feature|informative| See [[Arma 3: Task Framework]] for more information.}}

|s1= [taskId, [taskDescription, taskTitle, taskMarker]] call [[BIS_fnc_taskSetDescription]]

|p1= taskId: [[String]]

	"tsk_destroyAA",
	[
		"You should plant Satchels under those Shilkas! Good luck.",
		"Destroy the Shilkas",
		"Shilkas"
	]
] call BIS_fnc_taskSetDescription;</sqf>
